nodes.label: DoTDamage
nodes.description: DoT (Damage over Time) calculation module. Defines DoT types (Bleed, Burn, Poison), stat scalings, damage type mappings, and functions for computing DoT tick damage, potency multipliers, and display potency with Endless Despair modifier.

nodes.label: DOT_TYPE_LIST
nodes.description: ReadonlyArray of DoT type names: 'Bleed', 'Burn', 'Poison'

nodes.label: DOT_SCALINGS
nodes.description: Stat scaling definitions per DoT type. Bleed=dexterity+physical, Burn=fire×1.5, Poison=hex+earth, Caustic Slow=hex+earth

nodes.label: DOT_DMG_TYPE_MAP
nodes.description: Maps each DoT type to the damage type used for defense mitigation (Bleed→physical, Burn→fire, Poison→hex, Caustic Slow→true)

nodes.label: getDotBase
nodes.description: Returns flat base damage before potency multiplier. Formula: DOT_BASE_DAMAGE × (1 + inflictionPotency / DOT_INFLICTION_DIVISOR)

nodes.label: getDotPotencyMult
nodes.description: Returns potency multiplier: (1 + dotPotency)^(1 + min(1, dotPotency)). Exponent caps at 2 when dotPotency >= 1.0

nodes.label: calcDotTick
nodes.description: Computes a single DoT tick for given dotPotency and inflictionPotency. Combines getDotBase and getDotPotencyMult with rounding.

nodes.label: toGamePotency
nodes.description: Converts builder-display perk value to game-internal value (×0.1)

nodes.label: calcDotDisplayPotency
nodes.description: Computes effective DoT display potency applying Endless Despair modifier when present

nodes.label: HealBoost
nodes.description: Heal boost multiplier calculation module. Defines healing sources (perks, runes, weapon arts, passives) and computes the combined heal multiplier by iterating over HealBoostDef entries, applying conditions, and multiplying results. Handles level healing, Emotional, Heal Boost, Oceans Rage, Vampire sunlight, Frenzy self, Dragon Infusion holy, and Anti Heal reduction.

nodes.label: HealSource
nodes.description: Union type for healing sources: 'perk' | 'rune' | 'weaponArt' | 'passive'

nodes.label: HealBoostContext
nodes.description: Context for heal boost calculation containing perks, emotional state, darkness, level, draconic color, slider value, guild, rage potency, and active buffs

nodes.label: HealBoostResult
nodes.description: Result of heal boost calculation with individual entries and final multiplied multiplier

nodes.label: calculateHealBoost
nodes.description: Calculates combined heal boost multiplier from all active sources. Iterates over HealBoostDef entries, applies conditions and custom calcFns, multiplies all raw multipliers, and applies Anti Heal self-debuff reduction.

nodes.label: Perkbasedmg
nodes.description: Perk-based damage definitions. Large module defining ~30+ perk damage effects (Springblast, Bastion Ballista, spirits, Dragon State, Dragon Claw/Bubble, Volatile Shell, Dark Harvest, Pyre Bloom, etc.) with HP gate logic, secondary effects, trigger chains, proc coefficients, and dynamic damage type/scaling resolution.

nodes.label: gateThreshold
nodes.description: Returns the HP threshold for a gate, returning undefined if the perk amount meets alwaysActiveAtPerkAmount

nodes.label: isHpGateActive
nodes.description: Determines if an HP gate is active based on hpFillPct, perkAmount, and gate direction (aboveThreshold/belowThreshold)

nodes.label: DRAGON_STATE_HP_GATE
nodes.description: HP gate for Dragon State: 80% threshold (above), dynamically reduced by perk stacks

nodes.label: SECONDARY_TONE_COLORS
nodes.description: Color mapping for secondary effect tones: defense=#f87171, offense=#fb923c, utility=#8a8d85

nodes.label: calcSpringblastBaseDamage
nodes.description: Calculates Springblast base damage from perk amount using constants SPRINGBLAST_BASE_HIT, PER_STACK_HIT, MULT_PER_STACK

nodes.label: calcBomberChargeBaseDamage
nodes.description: Calculates Bomber Charge base damage factoring in missing HP percentage with a cap

nodes.label: PERK_DMG_DEFS
nodes.description: Array of PerkDmgDef objects defining all perk damage effects: Springblast, Bastion Ballista, Basic/Buni/Mageling/Toadzerker/Dire Buni/Void Root/Bomber/Roguent Spirits, Bounce Momentum, Bomber Charge, Protector Spirit, Air Pressure/Barrier, Apollo Boost, Dragon Claw/Bubble, Roaring Heads, Barbed Flurry, Honey Arts, Sickness, Melting Slime, Whirlwind, Dragon State, Volatile Shell, Spore Burst, Royal Finisher, Grounded Despair, Echo Incineration, Bombardier, Venom Spitter, Cauterize, Steam Charge, Quarry, Wind Drill, Fiery Pursuit, Bulfrogg/Gremlin/Queen Bumblz Spirits, Pyre Bloom, Dark Harvest.

nodes.label: findPerkDmgDef
nodes.description: Looks up a PerkDmgDef by perk name and optional label from the internal map

nodes.label: Runebasedmg
nodes.description: Rune-based damage definitions. Defines damage for 14 rune types (Ancient Cleric, Beenade, Boostshroom, Thunderous Charge, Sporeling Toss, Foot Dive, Caci, Cacitrops, Hex Web, Brainblast, Fireball, Rocky Tail, False Sun, Snoeball) with slider-based and potency-based hit counts, shield defs, and heal-only runes.

nodes.label: RUNE_DMG_DEFS
nodes.description: Array of RuneDmgDef objects defining damage, types, scalings, hit counts, notes, sliders, and shields for each rune

nodes.label: SummonData
nodes.description: Summon data module. Defines summon stat calculation, max summon count (base 15 + Swarm perk), summon definitions (Mage Bomber, Blessedling), WA-to-summon name mapping, and summon perk definitions.

nodes.label: calcSummonStat
nodes.description: Calculates summon stat: base × (1 + (summonBoostPct/100) × (1 + level/MAX_LEVEL)), rounded to 2 decimals

nodes.label: calcMaxSummonCount
nodes.description: Returns max summon count: 15 + floor(Swarm perk amount)

nodes.label: SUMMON_MAP
nodes.description: Map of summon name to SummonDef objects (Mage Bomber, Blessedling)

nodes.label: WA_SUMMON_MAP
nodes.description: Mapping from weapon art summon names to base summon names

nodes.label: cdr
nodes.description: Cooldown reduction perk data module. Defines CDR entries for perks: Caster, Channeled Weapon, Mage Rage, Poison Acceleration, Runic Winds, Wave Rider, Whirlwind, Gladiatorial Rage, and Voltaic Body with rune/WA percentage reductions, multipliers, filters, and toggle flags.

nodes.label: CDR_PERK_DATA
nodes.description: Record mapping perk names to PerkCDREntry objects with runePct, waPct, runeMultiplier, waMultiplier, runeSetCD, filters, and toggleable flag

nodes.label: defensivePerks
nodes.description: Defensive perk calculations. Defines 13 defensive perk sources (Barbskin, Stoneskin, Adaptive Plate ×2, Protector Spirit, Air Pressure, Valor, Vampire, Frenzy, Stored Corruption, Mounted Defense, Carapace, Cursed Bark) with DR per stack, conditions, HP thresholds, and custom DR functions. Also calculates defensive potency multiplier from Bastion Bless and Draconic Infusion.

nodes.label: getActiveDefensivePerkSources
nodes.description: Returns array of active defensive perk sources given current game state (perks, HP, conditions). Filters by HP thresholds, darkness, rage, mount, shield, and debuff count.

nodes.label: calcDefensivePotencyMult
nodes.description: Calculates defensive potency multiplier from Bastion Bless stacks and Draconic Holy Infusion

nodes.label: draconicBuffs
nodes.description: Draconic infusion buff calculations. Computes potency/duration multipliers from Draconic Blood perk, generates GrantedBuff objects for draconic infusion (per-color effects: air=atk speed+knockback, fire=burn+potency, hex=debuff potency+duration, holy=healing+buff potency, water=immunity+pulse, earth=poise+stun res), and generates ability debuffs for Dragon Claw/Bubble (Hex→random debuffs, Fire→burn).

nodes.label: getDraconicInfusionPotMult
nodes.description: Returns draconic infusion potency multiplier: 1 + perkAmt × DRACONIC_INFUSION_POT_MULT

nodes.label: getDraconicInfusionDurMult
nodes.description: Returns draconic infusion duration multiplier: 1 + perkAmt × DRACONIC_INFUSION_DUR_MULT

nodes.label: getEffectiveDraconicInfusionPotency
nodes.description: Computes effective draconic infusion potency by generating raw buffs then applying buff perk modifiers from BuffData

nodes.label: getDraconicInfusionBuff
nodes.description: Generates GrantedBuff array for draconic infusion based on guild, rune infusion type, color, and perk amount. Returns empty if not Draconic guild or not infusion type.

nodes.label: getDraconicAbilityDebuffs
nodes.description: Generates debuff GrantedBuff array for Dragon Claw/Bubble abilities based on color (Hex→Weakness+random pool, Fire→Burn, others→empty)

nodes.label: draconicColorEffects
nodes.description: Draconic color-based attack stats. Defines attack modifiers per draconic color (fire, air, earth, water, holy, hex) including damage multipliers, speed, knockback, cooldown, stun, burn/weakness application, and random debuff chances.

nodes.label: DRACONIC_COLOR_ATTACK_STATS
nodes.description: Array of DraconicColorAttackStats defining per-color combat modifiers (fire, air, earth, water, holy, hex) with stat type, hex color, and various multiplier/effect flags

nodes.label: getDraconicColorDmgMultiplier
nodes.description: Returns damage multiplier for a draconic color (earth×1.5, water×1.1, others×1.0), defaulting to 1

nodes.label: raceEffects
nodes.description: Race-based conditional effects module. Defines Human race passive (below 50% HP: ×1.2 dmg, 20% flat DR) and Ork Tenacity logic (bonus per unique non-debuff, non-neutral buff).

nodes.label: getActiveRaceEffect
nodes.description: Returns the active RaceConditionalEffect for a given race name and HP fill percentage using isHpGateActive

nodes.label: getOrkTenacityBuffs
nodes.description: Filters buffs to only unique, non-debuff, non-self-debuff, non-neutral buffs for Ork Tenacity bonus calculation

nodes.label: calcOrkTenacityBonus
nodes.description: Calculates Ork Tenacity bonus: 0.1 × count of unique qualifying buffs

nodes.label: constants
nodes.description: Barrel re-export module. Re-exports everything from ./constants/index which aggregates all constant sub-modules.

nodes.label: dot-damage constants
nodes.description: DoT damage constants: DOT_BASE_DAMAGE=1.75, DOT_INFLICTION_DIVISOR=1.1, DOT_POTENCY_POWER_CAP=1, DOT_ROUND_FACTOR=1000, DOT_BUILDER_TO_GAME=0.1

nodes.label: DOT_BASE_DAMAGE
nodes.description: Base damage constant for DoT ticks: 1.75

nodes.label: DOT_INFLICTION_DIVISOR
nodes.description: Divisor for infliction potency in DoT base formula: 1.1

nodes.label: DOT_POTENCY_POWER_CAP
nodes.description: Maximum exponent power for DoT potency multiplier: 1

nodes.label: DOT_ROUND_FACTOR
nodes.description: Rounding factor for DoT calculations: 1000

nodes.label: DOT_BUILDER_TO_GAME
nodes.description: Conversion factor from builder display value to game value: 0.1

nodes.label: rune-base-damage constants
nodes.description: Rune base damage constants for all rune types: Ancient Cleric (base 0.5, shield 20+4/val), Beenade (11, max potency 5), Boostshroom (3), Thunderous Charge (20), Sporeling Toss (3.5, 2 hits base), Foot Dive (18), Caci (5×3), Cacitrops (4×27), Hex Web (2×10), Brainblast (10×2), Rocky Tail (8 with protection scaling and hit divisor logic).

nodes.label: ANCIENT_CLERIC_BASE_DMG
nodes.description: Ancient Cleric rune base heal: 0.5

nodes.label: BEENADE_BASE_DMG
nodes.description: Beenade rune base damage: 11

nodes.label: BOOSTSHROOM_BASE_DMG
nodes.description: Boostshroom rune base damage: 3

nodes.label: THUNDEROUS_CHARGE_BASE_DMG
nodes.description: Thunderous Charge rune base damage: 20

nodes.label: SPORELING_TOSS_BASE_DMG
nodes.description: Sporeling Toss rune base damage: 3.5

nodes.label: ROCKY_TAIL_BASE_DMG
nodes.description: Rocky Tail rune base damage: 8

nodes.label: toast store
nodes.description: Toast notification Svelte writable store. Manages a list of Toast objects with id, message, type (success/error/info/warning), and optional auto-dismiss duration.

nodes.label: toasts
nodes.description: Svelte writable store holding the current Toast[] array

nodes.label: addToast
nodes.description: Adds a toast notification to the store with auto-incrementing id, optional type, and auto-removal after duration

nodes.label: removeToast
nodes.description: Removes a toast by id from the store

edges.label: imports DOT_BASE_DAMAGE, DOT_INFLICTION_DIVISOR, DOT_POTENCY_POWER_CAP, DOT_ROUND_FACTOR, DOT_BUILDER_TO_GAME
calls getDotBase to compute flat base damage
imports EMOTIONAL_MULT_PER_STACK, HEAL_BOOST_MULT_PER_STACK, MAX_LEVEL, OCEANS_RAGE_MULT_PER_STACK, VAMPIRE_SUNLIGHT_HEAL_MULT
calls getEffectiveDraconicInfusionPotency for Dragon Infusion (Holy) heal boost
imports ~70+ perk base damage constants (DRAGON_STATE_*, SPRINGBLAST_*, BOMBER_*, etc.)
Cauterize perk calls getDotPotencyMult for burn potency scaling
Dragon Claw secondary effect calls getDraconicColorDmgMultiplier
Dragon Bubble secondary effect calls getDraconicColorDmgMultiplier
calculateRuneHealScaling calls calculateHealBoost for heal-only runes
Sporeling Toss slider getMax calls calcMaxSummonCount for cap

imports CDR_CASTER_RUNE_PCT, CDR_CASTER_WA_PCT, CDR_CHANNELED_WEAPON_*, CDR_MAGE_RAGE_RUNE_PCT, CDR_POISON_ACCEL_*, CDR_RUNIC_WINDS_RUNE_PCT, CDR_WAVE_RIDER_WA_PCT, CDR_WHIRLWIND_*, CDR_GLADIATORIAL_SET_CD, CDR_VOLTAIC_BODY_MULT
imports 20 defensive constants (BASTION_BLESS_MULT, BARBSKIN_DR_PER_STACK, STONESKIN_*, ADAPTIVE_PLATE_*, etc.)
calls getDraconicInfusionPotMult for Holy Infusion defensive potency
calls getDraconicInfusionBuff to get raw buffs
calls applyBuffPerkModifiers from BuffData to modify potency
imports DRACONIC_FIRE_SPEED_MULT, DRACONIC_AIR_*, DRACONIC_EARTH_*, DRACONIC_WATER_*, DRACONIC_HEX_*
imports HpGate type and isHpGateActive function
calls isHpGateActive to check if race conditional effect is active
addToast updates the toasts writable store
removeToast updates the toasts writable store

exports RUNE_DMG_DEFS array of rune damage definitions
